_doc: Ilun's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/vowbound/ilun.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/ilun/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. He is bound light (color_script.md rule 2, C10): every emissive slot is glimmer_bound #4FB3B0 at energy 1.2 with no pulse (steady: no flicker, no drift). body is the disc, head lobes and tail (deep_teal_shadow to lagoon_teal by vertex colour, a pale belly), membrane the wings (paling to salt_glass at the thin margins); both carry a faint inner light (a low emission mask) and a back-lit rim sheen, so the opaque shader reads him as spectral. net is the knotted net of light on the membranes (emission mask 1). crest is the heron's plumes (salt_glass, lit along the shafts). eye is soft and glowing. glass is the keepsake, the child's net-float: salt_glass, wet and glossy, and not lit (it is the one part of him that is an object). cord is its sand_cloth net and tie. Colours are palette.json swatches.

held._doc: M3-CRE-647, the held form for the Ch20 release fight (act3_roster.md, The Vowbound as foes): write_materials.py writes materials_held/, every emissive slot's glimmer_bound (#4FB3B0) as glimmer_held (#7FC6D9) at the same energy, steady (color_script.md rule 1: held light is cool cyan); the other slots as they are. The held battle scene wears it; the release turns it to glimmer_lift (presentation).
